name: @driftbox/engine
description: A TR-808, a TR-909 and two TB-303s, synthesised from scratch with Web Audio. No samples.
author: Louis Emmett
//files: src ships alongside dist. The declaration maps and source maps in dist point at ../src/*.ts, so without it they dangle and 'go to definition' lands nowhere. It is also the more useful half of this package to have on hand: the reasoning in this engine lives in its comments, and a consumer who wants to know why the trim is applied after the waveshaper should be able to read that rather than infer it from minified output.
